_source.paper: GRAM: Gramian Multimodal Representation Learning and Alignment (ICLR 2025)
_source.model_row: GRAM (the paper's own model, VAST backbone + Gramian alignment, pretrained on VAST27M-150k)
_source.metrics: R@1 and R@10, in percent. The paper does NOT report R@5, so only @1/@10 are listed here.

tables.zeroshot: Table 1 (main) / Tables 8-9 (appendix, T2V and V2T split)

_source.verification: R@1 values transcribed and cross-checked against the arXiv HTML full text. R@10 values are carried over from the numbers already embedded in benchmark_eval/eval_summary.py and make_results_xlsx.py, which agree with each other; they were not individually re-read from the paper HTML.
_source.modality_codes: tv = text+video, tva = text+video+audio, tvas = text+video+audio+subtitle

audio_zeroshot._note: AudioCaps is text-video-audio retrieval (R@1/R@10); VGGSound-5K is T-AV classification (Acc@1/Acc@10).
